name: academy
description: Role-based plugins for research mathematics: a base plugin, four role plugins (Author, Researcher, Expert, Scientist) and domain packs.

plugins.name: academy
plugins.description: Base plugin: generic mathematical best practices (rigor, status vocabulary, citation and notation discipline, honest reporting) and shared plumbing: the board, review packets, the registry engine and the MCP server.

plugins.name: author
plugins.description: Author role: writes and maintains one research paper in LaTeX from established results, driven by a precedence-ordered agenda.

plugins.name: researcher
plugins.description: Researcher role: owns a research domain's notebook of definitions, claims, conjectures and directions; proves, reviews experiments, and generalizes experiment conclusions into conjectures with falsifiers.

plugins.name: expert
plugins.description: Expert role: keeps the source library (cited papers, cards, bibliography) and runs independent proof review and refereeing.

plugins.name: scientist
plugins.description: Scientist role: designs, codes, runs and reports computational experiments with provenance, across configurable environments.

plugins.name: ts-domain
plugins.description: Domain pack: translation surfaces and rational billiards.
